speaker: Doctor
text: I see you are experiencing fatigue, abdominal pain, night sweats, weight loss, and enlarged supraclavicular lymph nodes. To begin narrowing down the cause, have you noticed if these lymph nodes are hard, fixed to surrounding tissues, or if they are tender to the touch?

speaker: Patient
text: I have been feeling very tired and have had worsening abdominal pain for about four weeks. I have also had drenching night sweats and lost about twelve pounds.

speaker: Doctor
text:
The symptoms of "drenching night sweats" and significant weight loss (12 lbs in 4 weeks) alongside supraclavicular lymphadenopathy are concerning for a systemic process like malignancy or infection. Given the abdominal pain, have you noticed any changes in your bowel habits, or have you experienced blood in your stool or vomit?
